newsitem.title: FRANCE: Schiphol still top airport for Jan-Aug cargo gains.
newsitem.headline: Schiphol still top airport for Jan-Aug cargo gains.

text.p: Amsterdam's Schiphol airport recorded the highest percentage gain in cargo traffic last month among the EU's top cargo-handling airports, figures issued by the Paris airports authority, Aeroports de Paris (ADP) show.
Cargo traffic handled at Schiphol in August 1996 totalled 83,900 tonnes, up 16.5 percent on the same month in 1995.
The three London airports (Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted) handled 115,800 tonnes of cargo traffic last month, a rise of 6.8 percent on August 1995.
At Frankfurt airport, August 1996 cargo throughput totalled 108,100 tonnes, up 4.4 percent on the same month last year.
Cargo throughput at the Paris airports (Charles de Gaulle and Orly) last month grew by 1.7 percent on August 1995 to 87,564 tonnes.

Of the EU's top four cargo-handling airports, Amsterdam also recorded the highest percentage gain in cargo traffic in the first eight months of 1996 with volume rising by 11.3 percent to 694,400 tonnes.
January-August 1996 cargo traffic handled at the London airports totalled 934,200 tonnes, up 4.9 percent on 1995 levels.
Frankfurt airport's cargo throughput totalled 860,400 tonnes, up 2.2 percent on the same period last year.
January-August 1996 cargo traffic handled at the Paris airports declined by one percent on 1995 levels to 720,788 tonnes. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
